name: Fortress Trust
rootCause: On September 7, crypto trust company Fortress said on twitter that its customers were affected by a "compromised third-party provider of cloud tools," but that there was no loss of funds. On September 13, Fortress Trust founder and CEO Scott Purcell said that the company lost $12 million to $15 million in cryptocurrencies in a recent hack, most of which was Bitcoin but two stablecoins. A small amount of USDC and USDT were also stolen, and the company immediately made up for the loss. "Of the 225,000 customers, only 4 customers were actually affected." Purcell repeatedly emphasized that the fault of the security breach lies with the third-party provider…

descriptions.text: On September 7, crypto trust company Fortress said on twitter that its customers were affected by a "compromised third-party provider of cloud tools," but that there was no loss of funds. On September 13, Fortress Trust founder and CEO Scott Purcell said that the company lost $12 million to $15 million in cryptocurrencies in a recent hack, most of which was Bitcoin but two stablecoins. A small amount of USDC and USDT were also stolen, and the company immediately made up for the loss. "Of the 225,000 customers, only 4 customers were actually affected." Purcell repeatedly emphasized that the fault of the security breach lies with the third-party provider…

Fortress Trust lost between $12 million and $15 million in customer assets after attackers compromised a third-party cloud portal provider via a phishing and infrastructure attack. Ripple reimbursed affected customers as part of an acquisition agreement. Attackers gained unauthorized access through a phishing attack on the third-party cloud provider Retool, allowing them to compromise Fortress Trust customer accounts and extract custodial assets. The compromise bypassed multi-factor authentication safeguards.
